title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to produce sparse models by driving some feature coefficients to zero. This can help in feature selection.

title: Comparing L1 and L2 Regularization
text: While L1 regularization can help in identifying the most predictive features, it often results in a higher average loss compared to L2 regularization. This is because L2 regularization tends to distribute the penalty across all coefficients, leading to smaller individual penalties.

title: Evaluating Statements about L1 Regularization
text: Consider the statement: 'L1 regularization will generally result in higher average loss.' Is this statement true or false?

title: Impact of Regularization on Model Performance
text: Regularization techniques like L1 and L2 are used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. However, they can also affect the model's performance in terms of loss.
